text:
Type: pedestal block candle holder
Use: holding a pillar candle on a table, shelf or mantel; living room, dining room
Style: traditional, classic, rustic
Materials: smooth glazed ceramic with a soft satin sheen
Colors: dark grey-brown, charcoal
Shape: baluster-turned stem with rounded knobs, wide flat drip plate on top, broad round foot, tall and slender candlestick silhouette
Feel: elegant, moody, warm, timeless
Goes with: white or ivory candles, dark wood, linen tablecloths, brass accents; traditional, classic or farmhouse dining rooms

product.name: ERSTTA
product.description: It's easy to make a decorative candle arrangement by combining several ERSTTA block candle holders in different heights.
